groups.name: Prettier ignore configuration
groups.rationale: Adds the .lavish/ directory to prettier's ignore list so recorded review artifacts are not reformatted as source code.
groups.watch: The comment must accurately describe .lavish/ as review artifacts that should never be edited as source, not as generated output that prettier should skip.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
